First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it’s a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:15 pm. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Expect 14–16 mph: steady — you’ll breathe hard on the hills. It’s no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That’s the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Sylvan Park Tuesday Night Ride group ride

Sylvan Park Tuesday Night Ride is a road group ride in Nashville, TN. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:15 pm from Ride615 Sylvan Park.

A no-drop road ride that leaves the Ride615 shop in Sylvan Park. The shop lists the pace at 14 to 16 mph average. It runs weather permitting, so check with the shop first.
